Analysis.PFun.description: The type of domain-carrying real functions: a total map paired with its domain.

Analysis.mkPFun.description: Bundle a total map with a domain into a PFun.

Analysis.map.description: The underlying total map of a PFun or Seq.

Analysis.Seq.description: The type of real sequences carrying an index window.

Analysis.mkSeq.description: Bundle a map with its initial and final index.

Analysis.init.description: First index of a sequence's window.

Analysis.final.description: One past the last index of a sequence's window; absent for an infinite sequence.

Analysis.funLim.description: Function limit predicate (epsilon-delta) at a finite point.

Analysis.funConv.description: The function admits some limit at the given point.

Analysis.contOnIcc.description: Continuity on a closed interval: interior continuity plus one-sided continuity at the endpoints.

Analysis.deriv.description: Derivative predicate: the value is the limit of the difference quotient.

Analysis.diff.description: Differential operator sending a function to its derivative function.

Analysis.taylorPoly.description: Taylor polynomial of order n at a base point.

Analysis.rIntegrable.description: Riemann integrability on a closed interval.

Analysis.seqLimVal.description: Value form: the limit as a partial value (absent when the limit does not exist). Companion to the predicate macro of the same family.

Analysis.funLimVal.description: Value form: the limit as a partial value (absent when the limit does not exist). Companion to the predicate macro of the same family.

Analysis.limLeftVal.description: Value form: the limit as a partial value (absent when the limit does not exist). Companion to the predicate macro of the same family.

Analysis.limRightVal.description: Value form: the limit as a partial value (absent when the limit does not exist). Companion to the predicate macro of the same family.

Analysis.limNegInfVal.description: Value form: the limit as a partial value (absent when the limit does not exist). Companion to the predicate macro of the same family.

Analysis.limPosInfVal.description: Value form: the limit as a partial value (absent when the limit does not exist). Companion to the predicate macro of the same family.

Analysis.limInfVal.description: Value form: the limit as a partial value (absent when the limit does not exist). Companion to the predicate macro of the same family.

Analysis.isDeriv.description: A derivative relation between two real functions.
